1612828f4127e4c0045ef0435abb1f3b.overview: Ranjit, a farmer in India, takes on the fight of his life when he demands justice for his 13-year-old daughter, the victim of a brutal gang rape. His decision to support his daughter is virtually unheard of, and his journey unprecedented.
1612828f4127e4c0045ef0435abb1f3b.tagline: A man. His daughter. The trial of their lives.

1618531270326877de363357e6c190e0.overview: The timid youngest son of the most important family in town must use his wits to win the respect of his strong father and the love of a beautiful new woman in town.
1618531270326877de363357e6c190e0.tagline: "The Freshman" is down on the farm! And there's a real plot with bashful love-making and everything!

168204c1468a4dcedd708c9c12d7480d.overview: A destitute young man, raised by racist skinheads and notorious among white supremacists, turns his back on hatred and violence to transform his life, with the help of a black activist and the woman he loves.

168a7117bda7ffe234717f209de58360.overview: Cosmo Vittelli, the proprietor of a sleazy, low-rent Hollywood cabaret, has a real affection for the women who strip in his peepshows and the staff who keep up his dingy establishment. He also has a major gambling problem that has gotten him in trouble before. When Cosmo loses big-time at an underground casino run by mobster Mort, he isn't able to pay up. Mort then offers Cosmo the chance to pay back his debt by knocking off a pesky, Mafia-protected bookie.

1692bb3f077371fc36a7541f490b47e1.overview: At the end of the 19th century, Shanghai is divided into several foreign concessions. In the British concession, a number of luxurious “flower houses” are reserved for the male elite of the city. Since Chinese dignitaries are not allowed to frequent brothels, these establishments are the only ones that these men can visit. They form a self-contained world, with its own rites, traditions and even its own language. The men don’t only visit the houses to frequent the courtesans but also to dine, smoke opium, play mahjong and relax. The women working there are known as the “flowers of Shanghai”.

16b2f957352df9e767cb5718ce5d0562.overview: A former vaudeville child star viciously torments her paraplegic sister in their decaying Hollywood mansion.
16b2f957352df9e767cb5718ce5d0562.tagline: Sister, sister, oh so fair, why is there blood all over your hair?

16c5358046f6258ec05445ad5dc451b4.overview: A recovering alcoholic and jazz pianist in NYC confronts his acerbic family during their annual Fourth of July vacation.

16d2bf5fbfe72a652d50b3079345cb8f.overview: George Bailey has spent his entire life giving to the people of Bedford Falls.  All that prevents rich skinflint Mr. Potter from taking over the entire town is George's modest building and loan company.  But on Christmas Eve the business's $8,000 is lost and George's troubles begin.
16d2bf5fbfe72a652d50b3079345cb8f.tagline: It's a wonderful laugh! It's a wonderful love!
